backtest_protocol.execution_model: Operating lease liability is read as a raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT fact and matched to annual revenue ending the same fiscal-year date; all fields are known only by filed date <= signal date. The rule requires operating lease liability / revenue burden to fall year over year while revenue is non-declining and lease liability grows at least 2pp slower than revenue. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts

2_history_check.exp-20260528-017: Accepted low-liability support inside the older Companyfacts+RS stack. This run is not a generic liabilities/assets scalar; it tests a standalone candidate source using a specific lease fixed-cost burden trajectory.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-004/005: Recent raw Companyfacts interest and tax burden scouts failed. This run leaves financing/tax burden and tests operating lease fixed-cost relief.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-010: Rejected SG&A operating-expense leverage. This run is a balance-sheet lease-obligation burden field, not an income-statement SG&A expense ratio or marketing tag sweep.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-021/023: Rejected receivables DSO and allowance quality. This run exits the working-capital collection-quality family.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-024: Rejected FINRA borrow-pressure three-window validation. This run does not retune borrow, FTD, or short-interest fields.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Operating lease liabilities are broad PIT SEC balance-sheet facts not covered by the recent receivables, inventory, SBC, interest, tax, FINRA, or Form 4 experiments. Falling lease burden can represent fixed-cost relief and operating leverage, but broad Companyfacts quality scouts are saturated and may fail accepted comparators.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC operating lease liability or annual revenue facts; missing matching fiscal-year ends; stale facts; missing CIK mapping; missing OHLCV; missing next open; or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC operating lease liability and revenue filed-date PIT mapping, lease burden relief gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
